checks.name: ffmpeg
checks.detail: FFmpeg normalizes files and records microphone audio.

checks.name: ffprobe
checks.detail: FFprobe improves duration and audio metadata detection.
checks.remediation: optional but recommended; set COMLINK_FFPROBE or install ffprobe

checks.name: asr
checks.detail: Local ASR uses whisper.cpp through whisper-cli.
checks.remediation: set COMLINK_WHISPER_CPP to whisper-cli or install whisper.cpp

checks.name: model-path
checks.remediation: set COMLINK_WHISPER_MODEL or run comlink models select <name> --path <file>

checks.name: clipboard-copy
checks.detail: Clipboard delivery uses pbcopy or COMLINK_PBCOPY.
checks.remediation: install macOS pbcopy support or set COMLINK_PBCOPY to an executable test adapter

checks.name: clipboard-read
checks.detail: Clipboard restore uses pbpaste or COMLINK_PBPASTE.
checks.remediation: optional; install macOS pbpaste support or set COMLINK_PBPASTE

checks.name: data-path
checks.detail: Data directory is present or can be created.
checks.remediation: set COMLINK_DATA_DIR to a writable directory

checks.name: system-audio
checks.detail: No BlackHole virtual audio input was detected in AVFoundation devices.
checks.remediation: Install BlackHole 2ch or 16ch, create a Multi-Output or Aggregate Device for speakers plus BlackHole, and rerun doctor. If COMLINK_SYSTEM_AUDIO_DEVICE is set, it must name a detected BlackHole input.

checks.name: microphone
checks.detail: record uses FFmpeg AVFoundation input device :0
checks.remediation: grant Terminal microphone permission in macOS Privacy & Security; override with COMLINK_RECORD_DEVICE or record --device

privacy.posture: local-first; ASR runs through local whisper.cpp; LLM rewrite is opt-in

system_audio.detail: No BlackHole virtual audio input was detected in AVFoundation devices.
system_audio.remediation: Install BlackHole 2ch or 16ch, create a Multi-Output or Aggregate Device for speakers plus BlackHole, and rerun doctor. If COMLINK_SYSTEM_AUDIO_DEVICE is set, it must name a detected BlackHole input.

dependency.name: BlackHole virtual audio device
dependency.detail: Chosen Phase 8 dependency for local Zoom/Teams system audio routing.

native_core_audio_tap.permission_model: Requires macOS system audio recording consent; doctor does not request or bypass TCC.
native_core_audio_tap.detail: Native Core Audio process taps are a future no-driver option, but are not the Phase 8 recommendation.
